opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other institutions of higher education in the UK, and on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations eligible by UKRI.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. Assessed via two-stage process (outline and detailed applications). The detailed application stage is open with a deadline of 1 September 2026.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except medical/clinical, policy, commercial, database assembly, advocacy, capacity building, networking, skills development

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers; some specialist arts institutions are permitted to apply.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research within the UK.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness/disabilities in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice or medical applications

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year one, 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three; up to £6,000 per annum research expenses. Approximately 145 Fellowships available in 2027.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate by the time of taking up the Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness/disabilities in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice or medical applications

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million will be made to UK universities in this round.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any UK university that holds research degree awarding powers in its own right; consortia of up to two universities also accepted.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to fund up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area. The Centenary Doctoral Scholarships round is open for submission in March 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical, policy-driven, advocacy, commercial, database assembly

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: The maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK at the time of application.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research. Applications materials will be available on this page in September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness/disabilities in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice or medical applications

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum value of £3,000 and a maximum of £24,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post, living in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks of the year, with an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication. Application materials will be available on this page during September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness/disabilities in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice or medical applications

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million is available for up to 10 years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers; may be single university or collaboration between multiple institutions.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Centenary Research Centre round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Replacement salary costs for the duration of the Fellowship; research expenses up to an annual maximum of £6,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences to complete a piece of original research. The closing date falls in May each year.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers at an early stage of their careers whose work has had international impact and whose future research career is exceptionally promising.
opportunities.summary: For researchers at an early stage of their careers whose work has had international impact and whose future research career is exceptionally promising, to use for any research purpose.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented scholars embarking on a university career who need to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem.
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars who are embarking on a university career who need to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. The next round will be the Centenary Research Leadership Awards.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts institutions or registered charities to provide training opportunities across the fine and performing arts.
opportunities.summary: For specialist arts institutions or registered charities to provide training opportunities across the fine and performing arts: music, drama, dance, film, fine art, etc.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts institutions or registered charities to provide support to undergraduate and/or postgraduate students across the fine and performing arts.
opportunities.summary: For specialist arts institutions or registered charities to provide support to undergraduate and/or postgraduate students across the fine and performing arts, including music, drama, dance, film, fine art, etc.
